source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The initial full-attendee fixture contains two calendarAttendeesSubview IDs and two expandedAttendees IDs. The later menu patch removes the earlier duplicate fragment and leaves one of each in that owned phase. This is an exact fixture-source correction across two commits. It is separate from the review's old move-menu-item correction and does not establish a reproduced test failure or that opening the menu fixes attendee behavior.
title: The later menu patch removes a duplicated attendee subview from the test fixture
